title: Excellence is preserved by finite type algebras and localization
statement: Let $R$ be an excellent commutative ring [def-exc-excellent-ring], let $A$ be a finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let $S\subseteq A$ be a multiplicative subset ($1\in S$ and $st\in S$ for $s,t\in S$). Then the localization $S^{-1}A$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is excellent. In particular $A$ is excellent by taking $S=\{1\}$.

proof.text: Unpack excellence of R using [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Its Noetherianity and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian] give Noetherianity of A. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-g-ring] to obtain the G-ring property for A. Neither application assumes injectivity of the algebra map.

source.place: Tag 07QU, lemma-finite-type-over-excellent, finite type case; Tag 07PV

proof.text: For any finite type A-algebra T, compose its structure map with R to A. Transitivity of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] makes T finite type over R. Finite type algebras are small relative to their coefficient ring (Algebra.FiniteType.small); replace T by Shrink T in the universe of R and transport its R-algebra structure by Shrink.algEquiv. Excellence of R gives openness of its regular locus and catenarity of this small model. Transport regular loci back along the spectrum comap homeomorphism: Localization.localRingEquiv identifies the corresponding local rings and IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv preserves regularity. Transport catenarity using the ideal order isomorphism: prime ideals, strict inclusions, endpoints, and prime ideals insertable between consecutive terms all correspond. Thus prime chains and saturated prime chains have the same lengths in both rings. These arguments are the two proved private helpers in Lean. This gives J-2 and universal catenarity of A, completing IsExcellent A by [def-exc-excellent-ring].

source.place: Tag 07QU, lemma-finite-type-over-excellent, first sentence; the Shrink transport handles the fixed-universe quantifiers of the Lean predicates

proof.text: Let B be LocalizedModule S A, definitionally the ring Localization S of [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian] with the Noetherianity of A to obtain Noetherianity of B. The localization map A to B is weakly etale in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]: Algebra.WeaklyEtale.of_isLocalization (Stacks Tag 092J(1)) supplies this directly, and RingHom.weaklyEtale_algebraMap_iff gives the ring-homomorphism form. Explicitly localization is flat and its tensor multiplication is an isomorphism, hence flat. This elementary specialization of the source library theorem requires no finite type hypothesis on B over A and no exclusion of zero from S.

Apply [lem-exc-weakly-etale-excellent] to the localization map A to B, the excellence of A proved above, the Noetherianity of B and weak etaleness from the preceding step. It gives IsExcellent B. Pair this with IsExcellent A to prove the stated conjunction. This replaces the longer componentwise localization argument by an existing declaration, without changing the unit statement or any unit proof step. All maps and arguments include the zero ring and submonoids containing zero.

source.place: Tag 07QU, localization assertion; proved here using the existing Greco Theorem 5.3(iv) ascent theorem
